name: Summer Recreation Program at Cunningham Park
description_short: Town summer program at Cunningham Park, a private park, for Milton residents ages 7 to 12 only (proof of residency required). Weekdays 8:30 to 3 for seven weeks, with field games, arts and crafts, field trips, special events and supervised swims for children who join the park pond.
swim_waterfront_notes: Supervised morning and afternoon swims at the Cunningham Park pond for enrolled children who also buy a pond membership through cunninghampark.org.
special_needs_notes: The department welcomes children with disabilities; each child, with or without added supports, must be able to take part in group activities and move between activities.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Milton Parks and Recreation 2026 summer program brochure: Summer Recreation Program at Cunningham Park, Milton residents only, proof of residency required, ages 7 to 12 (7 before June 29, 2026), Monday to Friday 8:30 to 3, June 29 to August 14, 2026, $800. Online registration from April 8. Weekly special events may carry a small fee. Milton Residents Fund may help families in financial crisis. The brochure gives no street address for Cunningham Park. The candidate URL was the 2025 to 26 program summary; this 2026 summer brochure has the dates.
